info.name: devops-learning-path API
info.description:
Task API with RS256 JWT auth, owner-scoped CRUD.

Run the whole collection top to bottom (Runner or Newman) -- every request asserts its expected status, and tokens and ids chain automatically between requests. Identities are generated per run, so it is safe to re-run.

Defaults to staging. To run against a local stack instead, change the collection variable baseUrl to http://localhost:8000.

Note: the first request against staging can take 10-20 seconds. The container scales to zero after 5 minutes idle and the database suspends its compute; a cold request pays both.

request.description: REUSE DETECTION. Two parties now hold the same token and the server cannot tell the legitimate client from a thief, so it assumes theft and revokes the whole family. The next request fails too, by design.

request.description: Otherwise logout becomes an oracle for whether a token is live.
Generic 401 -- no hint about why it failed.

An unsigned token claiming alg 'none' -- the classic JWT bypass. Works against any server that forgets to pin the algorithm list when verifying.

Rejected twice over: the app returns 401 (it pins RS256), and on staging Vercel's WAF blocks it at the edge with 403 before the request even arrives (x-vercel-mitigated: deny). Either is a pass.
